host.title: Host
host.description: The ctrlb server where you are sending logs.

port.title: Port
port.description: The port on the ctrlb server.

uri.title: URI
uri.description: The API path used to send logs.

format.title: Format
format.description: The format of the log payload.

compress.title: Compress
compress.description: Compresses the payload. Recommended to set to gzip for optimized log ingestion.

json_date_key.title: JSON Date Key
json_date_key.description: The JSON key used for timestamps in the logs.

json_date_format.title: JSON Date Format
json_date_format.description: The format of the date in logs.

include_tag_key.title: Include Tag Key
include_tag_key.description: If true, a tag is appended to the output using the tag_key property.

tag_key.title: Tag Key
tag_key.description: The key name for the tag when include_tag_key is enabled.
